# WordPress.org

> WordPress.org is the official home of WordPress, the world's most popular open-source CMS powering millions of websites, blogs, and applications.

WordPress.org provides free access to the WordPress software, thousands of themes and plugins, comprehensive documentation, and community resources. It serves as the central hub for WordPress downloads, extensions, education, and the global open-source community driving the platform's development.

## Key Topics

- WordPress
- Open-source CMS
- Gutenberg Block Editor
- WordPress Playground

## Getting Started

- [Download WordPress](https://wordpress.org/download): WordPress download page with installation instructions and system requirements.
- [WordPress Playground](https://wordpress.org/playground): Browser-based WordPress testing environment requiring no hosting setup.
- [WordPress Hosting Guide](https://wordpress.org/hosting): Guide to choosing WordPress hosting with recommendations and provider comparisons.
- [About WordPress](https://wordpress.org/about): WordPress mission, history, and founding story by Mike Little and Matt Mullenweg.

## Extensions & Customization

- [WordPress Plugins Directory](https://wordpress.org/plugins): Official repository of free plugins extending WordPress functionality across categories.
- [WordPress Themes Directory](https://wordpress.org/themes): Official directory of thousands of free WordPress themes for site customization.
- [Block Pattern Directory](https://wordpress.org/patterns): Directory of ready-to-use block patterns for WordPress site design and layouts.

## Editor & Publishing

- [Gutenberg Block Editor](https://wordpress.org/gutenberg): Gutenberg block editor overview showcasing new WordPress content creation experience.

## Documentation & Learning

- [WordPress Documentation](https://wordpress.org/documentation): Comprehensive WordPress documentation covering installation, security, and customization.
- [Education & Programs](https://wordpress.org/education): Educational programs and initiatives empowering open-source creators and contributors.

## Enterprise & Community

- [Enterprise Solutions](https://wordpress.org/enterprise): Enterprise solutions, use cases, and case studies for large-scale WordPress deployments.
- [Five for the Future](https://wordpress.org/five-for-the-future): Program encouraging organizations to contribute five percent resources to WordPress.

## Releases & News

- [WordPress 6.9 Release](https://wordpress.org/download/releases/6.9): WordPress 6.9 release notes featuring collaboration tools and editor enhancements.
- [WordPress 7.0 Beta 5](https://wordpress.org/news/2026/03/wordpress-7-0-beta-5): WordPress 7.0 Beta 5 release announcement with testing and download information.

## Optional

- [WordPress.org Homepage](https://wordpress.org): WordPress homepage showcasing open-source CMS platform for building websites, blogs, and apps.
